answer: Fund epoch rewards by quadratic matching with pairwise collusion bounds. Every donation is a signal of genuine support, and the matching pool rewards breadth: many small independent backers trigger a spiral of superlinear matching. But donor pairs that look correlated — one funding root, lockstep timing — get their pairwise match discounted toward linear. A sybil farm's puppets all wander out of the same wallet cluster, so their self-dealing harvests almost nothing while real projects keep the multiplier. Manufacturing breadth then costs the attacker more than the match pays.
